$comment: The es translation of narration.json, one entry per take. Translate `source` into `text`: same meaning and facts, plain spoken sentences, about the same length (a voiced take must fit its scene's window). Keep brand names as the brand writes them; how they are SPOKEN in es goes in brand-tokens.json brand.pronunciations with "lang": "es". Never edit `source` or `sourceHash`: npm run translate keeps them in step, and marks a take `stale` when its source line changes. Delete `stale` once `text` is re-translated.

takes.source: This film was made by a script, not an editor.
takes.text: Esta película la hizo un guion, no un editor.

takes.source: Explainer videos take weeks of edits, and the brand drifts with every one.
takes.text: Los videos explicativos llevan semanas de ediciones, y la marca se desvía con cada una.

takes.source: brand-film writes the film as an HTML scene, where every frame is a function of time.
takes.text: brand-film escribe la película como una escena HTML: cada fotograma, una función del tiempo.

takes.source: ElevenLabs voices each line, then listens back to check every name was said right.
takes.text: ElevenLabs pone voz a cada línea y luego la escucha, para comprobar que cada nombre se dijo bien.

takes.source: Headless Chrome renders each frame, and ffmpeg mixes the voice, music and captions.
takes.text: Chrome sin interfaz dibuja cada fotograma, y ffmpeg mezcla la voz, la música y los subtítulos.

takes.source: Your brand, your story, made in code. Find brand-film on GitHub.
takes.text: Tu marca, tu historia, hechas en código. Encuentra brand-film en GitHub.
